study.question: At identical product-forward values and native live RMS scaling, does deleting the coordinate-mean gradient direction disproportionately reduce useful auxiliary context transfer compared with a fixed alternating rank-one deletion?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: g0-r0063-uncentered_native reproduces the incumbent click AUC 0.6685268680, while g0-r0063-uncentered_forward_centered_backward reaches 0.6679801468 (difference -0.0005467212) and g0-r0063-centered_forward_uncentered_backward reaches 0.6676983006. Native centering reaches 0.6677041313. Thus changing either forward values or the entire normalizer VJP can harm this implementation; neither change isolates coordinate-mean gradient removal. The centered VJP also changes its scale and radial correction. g0-r0061-scale_detached_transfer (0.6670605582 versus 0.6685268680 live) independently makes scale derivatives consequential. Native centering reverses the transfer contrast in g0-r0062: centered enabled/blocked 0.6677041313/0.6680123226, uncentered enabled/blocked 0.6685268680/0.6678681339. Proposed explanation: the uniform coordinate direction of the pre-RMS product carries a useful component of the context-transfer learning signal. Removing that component alone should hurt enabled transfer more than blocking the same rank-one alternating direction, with a smaller enabled-minus-blocked effect under mean deletion. This is provisional: all cited scores use the same frozen training seed and long adaptive validation search; deterministic replays do not provide independent replication. The latest knowledge-usage record declared the g0-r0063 normalizer factorial; its executed crossed cells lost to native uncentered and do not validate the external methods cited there. Current agent-memory searches returned no records; trial receipts and runtime summaries supply the evidence.

nearest_work.difference: Inspected the standalone ancestor and its full validation receipt. It substitutes the complete centered-normalizer VJP while preserving uncentered forward values. This proposal inserts a rank-one projector before the unchanged native uncentered normalizer, so only one input-gradient direction is suppressed; the normalizer Jacobian is evaluated at the original product.

study.proposed_difference: For each task and sample let x=q*summary in FP32, R(x)=x/sqrt(mean(x^2)+1e-4). At training only define P_d=I-dd^T/16 with either d=(1,...,1) or d=(1,-1,...,1,-1). Form proxy=P_d x, then x_star=stopgrad(x)+(proxy-stopgrad(proxy)); feed x_star into the unchanged R. For finite tensors x_star equals x, and the upstream VJP is P_d J_R(x)^T g. This holds the complete native RMS Jacobian at x, including its scale derivative, before the single orthogonal deletion. Both projections execute in every training cell; an algebraic zero retains the unused graph. Eval bypasses the surrogate and uses the original R directly. No learned modules/buffers/RNG or loss hooks are added. The two projectors have equal rank, Frobenius norm and spectral norm; actual removed gradient magnitudes need not match. Cross direction with block_aux_adapter_context_grad False/True in four standalone cells. The deletion applies in every task product branch and therefore cannot alone attribute an effect exclusively to auxiliary embeddings. It deliberately uses a surrogate derivative rather than the true derivative of the forward loss.
predictions: Before host training, loading an identical incumbent state into all four cells should give identical finite train/eval forward probabilities at fixed batch state, unchanged parameter shapes/counts, and unchanged buffers/RNG consumption. Eval operator sequence remains native; no current label or unmasked history enters. Torch is absent locally, so these are host prerequisites, not completed tensor tests.

In a host local-gradient check with independent product x and upstream vector g, the helper VJP should equal P_d J_R(x)^T g, its component along d should be approximately zero, and the uncentered RMS value should match native. At x=0 or near zero epsilon must keep values and VJP finite. BF16 model integration tolerances must be recorded rather than assuming exact trajectory equality.

If uniform gradient direction specifically supports transfer, D_mean=AUC(mean_removed_transfer)-AUC(mean_removed_blocked) should be below D_alt=AUC(alternating_removed_transfer)-AUC(alternating_removed_blocked). The original native gap is 0.0006587341; mean deletion should shrink that gap more than the alternating deletion. The interaction is the primary mechanistic contrast, without a single-seed significance claim.

At enabled transfer, mean deletion should reduce click AUC more than alternating deletion relative to g0-r0063-uncentered_native. Comparison against g0-r0063-uncentered_forward_centered_backward distinguishes pure rank-one deletion from its complete centered-VJP intervention. Neither new cell is predicted to win by definition.

Report full-population click AUC/Logloss plus all four task metrics and measured training/inference costs. Existing DIN auxiliary AUCs exceed the incumbent auxiliary AUCs; a click gain is not an all-task gain. Predeclared history bins are empty, 1-16, 17-64, >64; report sample, positive and negative counts, marking small slices. Slice changes remain exploratory and are not the selection score.
falsifiers: D_mean >= D_alt, or enabled mean deletion retaining native click AUC while alternating deletion harms it, contradicts the predicted specific role of uniform gradient direction for this implementation.

Similar enabled/blocked changes for both directions are evidence for a nonspecific effect of gradient restriction, not coordinate-mean specificity. If neither approximates the g0-r0063 crossed-cell degradation, its changed normalization scale/radial correction remains the more plausible unresolved component.

A gain solely in auxiliary mean AUC, a tiny unreplicated validation increase, or an improvement only against weaker source references does not establish the claimed click mechanism or justify replacement of the incumbent.

Any failure of fixed-state forward parity, projector VJP, masking, parameter ownership, finite-gradient checks or the fixed contract invalidates attribution; preserve the failed receipt and charged cost. Local source/math checks cannot rule these out.
An advantage that disappears in a future authorized paired repetition or fails the measured quality-cost comparison remains unsupported. No held-out result is requested in this phase.
alternative_explanations: Uniform and alternating directions are both fixed in learned coordinates; their removed gradient norms, correlations and optimization effects can differ. Equal projector rank is not gradient-magnitude matching or semantic exchangeability.

The intervention changes every task product branch, including primary query/history projection parameters; its interaction with the auxiliary context gate does not uniquely identify an auxiliary-only causal path.
The coordinate mean can be relearned by rotating task projections. A one-pass optimization limitation can produce the contrast without a stable information-carrying subspace.

Removing any direction changes effective capacity of the backward update, shared-embedding interactions, dense clipping activation and optimizer trajectories although forward capacity and raw parameter counts match.

BF16 rounding, surrogate gradients, the shared normalization population and zero-initialized output maps may mediate effects. Original forward invariance at fixed weights does not imply trained-model invariance.

Earlier negative branches matter: event-level replacement g0-r0057-event_transfer (0.6683746776) lost to block transfer despite a higher blocked endpoint (0.6681215436); aligned/permuted detail in g0-r0060 (0.6684713087/0.6684445445) both lost to broadcast bridge (0.6685268680). More sequence detail has not reliably helped. Centered and scale-detached failures remain evidence rather than being discarded.

All observations are adaptive single-seed offline validation results with repeated user exposures; no independent-seed evidence, paired user-cluster intervals or new withheld results are available. Whole-window vocabulary/static snapshot assumptions and delayed historical feedback visibility remain frozen benchmark limitations.

contrasts.decision_if_supported: A negative interaction with enabled endpoint degradation supports the provisional transfer-direction explanation locally. Reserve an admissible gradient-magnitude control and repetition before claiming a mechanism; no priority claim follows.
contrasts.decision_if_not_supported: Do not interpret a main-effect score change as evidence for the transfer-direction mechanism. Prefer unchanged incumbent and preserve all four outcomes.
